summary: Created self-contained SDM executive demo page at content/sdm-exec-demo/index.html with 4 sections, Alpine interactions, Intersection Observer nav, and SRI on pinned Alpine/Lucide CDN scripts.
details:
## Deliverable
- `content/sdm-exec-demo/index.html` (452 lines)

## Sections
1. **Vision** — Hero with gradient, 3 animated stat cards, CTA to Live Work
2. **Live Work** — 3 expandable Phase 1 agent cards (Delivery Tracker, Risk Sentinel, Business Review Generator)
3. **Roadmap** — 7-phase timeline (0–6), click-to-detail, end-state callout, 4 collapsible agent chains
4. **Governance** — T1/T2/T3 trust tiers, CSS HITL flow diagram, 4 principles, footer

## Interactions
- Sticky nav with active section (Intersection Observer)
- Agent card expand/collapse (Alpine x-show)
- Phase timeline selection
- Chain accordion
- Smooth scroll

## Security
- Static hardcoded data only; Alpine x-text bindings
- SRI on Alpine 3.14.8 and Lucide 0.468.0
- Tailwind play CDN (same pattern as content/ai-factory/index.html — no stable SRI for JIT compiler)
- No localStorage/cookies/eval/innerHTML

## GitHub Pages (after push)
https://michabr4.github.io/windsurf-cursor-master/content/sdm-exec-demo/

Deployment steps in HTML comment at bottom of file.
